English: Watchmans Post
A rudimentary post of wooden stakes and a canvas shelter, manned by a handful of watchmen keeping an eye on the settlements outskirts.
Night Bell
A mounted iron bell and fire basket, tended by townfolk, to sound alarms at night and deter thieves or raiders.
Patrol Route
A marked and maintained patrol path, with crude lanterns and posts, allowing regular watch circuits through the growing settlement.
Guardhouse
A timber guardhouse, with a lockable store for arms and bunks for watchmen, overseeing the main street and market.
Signal Tower
A stone watchtower with signaling fires and horns, providing clear views and quick alerts to the city in times of danger.
Town Gaol
A secure stone gaol with barred cells and reinforced doors, housing criminals and maintaining order within the city.
Sentinel Barracks
A fortified barracks complex with stone walls, armories, and training yards, housing a sizable city watch detachment.
Gatehouse Keep
A powerful stone gatehouse and keep, anchoring the city walls and controlling all entry and exit, with rooms for officers and guards.
Perimeter Patrol
A coordinated watch system, with mounted patrols and signal relays, ensuring the entire city perimeter is vigilantly guarded.
Marshals Headquarters
An imposing headquarters with a command hall, record archives, and war room, from which the citys Marshal and captains direct all security, defense, and emergency measures.
